priority.instructions: Choose the scheduling class from urgency, deadline, blocker status and stated impact. Treat materially blocked or high-consequence work as escalation rather than ordinary run-now work; use unclear when the evidence is insufficient.

criteria.now: Time-sensitive and actionable work that should enter the active queue now, with no supplied blocker or consequence requiring human escalation.
criteria.later: Useful work with no immediate deadline, blocker or material consequence requiring active attention.
criteria.escalate: Overdue or materially blocked work, or work whose stated consequence warrants human attention before or alongside scheduling.
criteria.unclear: The scheduling evidence is mixed, incomplete or too ambiguous to choose now, later or escalate reliably.

state.task: Renew an already-approved staging certificate before its scheduled expiry.
state.impact: staging verification will stop after expiry
